arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test RFC2822 format with different timezone formats
fmt = 'a {:te} b'

tests = [
    ('+1000', 'a Mon, 21 Nov 2011 10:21:36 +1000 b'),
    ('+10:00', 'a Mon, 21 Nov 2011 10:21:36 +10:00 b'),
]

for name, t in tests:
    result = parse.parse(fmt, t)
    if result:
        tz = result[0].tzinfo
        print(f'{name:8} -> name={tz._name}, offset_sec={tz._offset.total_seconds()}')
    else:
        print(f'{name:8} -> None')
"
